app.title: Windwalker analyzer
app.stageNote: Alpha: the measurements are real, but the thresholds and the wording are still moving.
app.intro: Analyse a single Mists of Pandaria pull: how full your Tigereye Brew bank was when you spent it, whether your brews lined up with Re-Origination procs, where your rotation lost damage, and a list of every mistake with a link back to the replay. Everything runs in this tab.
app.privacy: There is no server, no cookies and no analytics. Nothing is stored except your token, and only until this tab closes. If you open DevTools → Network while it runs, you will see this page's own assets, POSTs to warcraftlogs.com, and spell icons from Wowhead's image host — the icon requests carry no token, no report code and nothing else.

chart.empty: There is nothing to draw for this pull.

settings.title: Analysis settings
settings.intent: Most of what this report checks is fixed by the spec and not something you can change. These settings are the exceptions — thresholds that depend on you, or that the log cannot tell us.

leeway.label: Snapshot leeway
leeway.hint: How much of a Re-Origination proc can be left over for a brew to still count as catching it on the last global. The default of {{default}}ms is one global, which is what the rotation asks for. Raise it if your latency means the log records you later than you acted, or if you deliberately brew with a safety cushion. Between {{min}} and {{max}}ms.

tigerPalm.label: Tiger Palm refresh window
tigerPalm.hint: How much Tiger Power can be left before a Tiger Palm counts as refreshing the buff instead of overwriting a buff that was still fine. The rotation refreshes it at {{min}}ms; the default of {{default}}ms is one global wider, because a person has to finish the global they are in before they can press. Between {{min}} and {{max}}ms.

cooldown.label: Cooldown leeway
cooldown.hint: How late a press can land after a cooldown comes back before the wait is counted as a cooldown held. A wait shorter than this is forgiven whole; a longer one is still charged whole. The default of {{default}}ms is the global you were already committed to when the button came up, plus half a global to see it and press it. Lower it to {{min}}ms for the strictest reading. Between {{min}} and {{max}}ms, and it applies to every button with a cooldown — Rising Sun Kick, Chi Wave, Xuen and the potion.

settings.storage: Kept in this browser only, and used by the analysis running in this tab. Changing it re-reads the pull that is already loaded — nothing is fetched from WarcraftLogs again.

credits.label: API credits
credits.signedOut: WarcraftLogs gives every API client its own hourly budget, so the one you register is yours alone to spend. What is left of it shows here once you are signed in.
credits.summary_one: {{percent, percent}} of this hour's WarcraftLogs budget left, which is about {{count, compact}} more pull.
credits.summary_other: {{percent, percent}} of this hour's WarcraftLogs budget left, which is about {{count, compact}} more pulls.
credits.used: {{spent, integer}} of {{limit, integer}} points spent this hour.
